card.fires_on: The word PDF or the bracket after it in book download listings, and the word "for" in "Directions/Instructions for Use" in drug labels.

modes.label: Download PDF listings
modes.description: The word PDF or the opening parenthesis after it, just before a file size in MB.

modes.label: Directions/Instructions for Use
modes.description: The word "for" right after "Directions" or "Instructions" when pointing to the use leaflet.
modes.example: Refer to Directions<< for>> Use accompanying the administration set.
